purpose: Exploratory development sensitivity of frozen model-minus-baseline metrics
unit: whole target day, including every eligible station and hour
resampling: overlapping non-circular moving blocks; truncate concatenated blocks to original number of days
paired: same sampled day indices for both candidates
metric: sum sampled confusion counts then calculate F1, precision, recall; report difference in percentage points
range: empirical 2.5th to 97.5th percentiles; descriptive, not guaranteed 95% coverage
